title: The Magnolia Band and Cherry Blossom Band members
summary: Keppard lists the players in his Magnolia Band, then the Cherry Blossom Band, playing at Economy Hall and Copperhead Hall.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: He was a great guitarist and a violinist. He's the one that composed that, the Wildcat, the Bumperche. What was that? Everything. He's the one that composed that. Now, we see, well, I used to play at the Economy Hall around the corner. And after that, I played at the Copperhead Hall. That was when I started playing. I had the Magnolia Band. Who was in that? Well, they had a fellow by the name of Dave Dupas. He used to play clarinet. And they had a fellow by Maurice Durand who was playing cornet. A new, uh... And after that, the band was just coming up. And we had this here fellow, Arnold... Arnold... Arnold... Uh... What's his name? Arnold Dupas. He was playing drum. His brother was playing clarinet. He was playing drum.
Baby Doss talking about Arnold Dupas.

And then they had... We had another fellow by the name of Sidney Desvien. He used to play clarinet too. Also, he used to work around for the band. And then he was playing on the part of the street. Well, I wasn't there. That's what they called the Magnolia Band at that time. And after that, we got to be... We broke it up and we put the Cherry Blossom Band. We broke up that and then I started getting... There's another man. And after we started getting that Cherry Blossom Band, then we continued. Then we bust up again. Then we started getting the band better and better. And I went up on third and... And magazine where Joe Oliver was working as a butler. He was a butler. He used to be a butler in that house. Doing garden work. And I went to him and seen him and talked to him about making him a band. And he wasn't playing with nobody. And he wasn't so extra. He wasn't so built up for reputation.
